methods.name: Rows.Add
methods.returnDescription: The index of the new row.
methods.description: Adds a row with one value per column (for an unbound grid).

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: The cell values, in column order.

methods.expectedEffect: A new row appears at the bottom.

methods.name: Rows.RemoveAt
methods.description: Removes the row at the given index (unbound grids).

methods.name: Columns.Add
methods.returnDescription: The index of the new column.

parameters.name: columnName
parameters.description: The column's Name, used in Cells["Name"].

parameters.name: headerText
parameters.description: The caption in the header row.

methods.expectedEffect: A City column appears at the right.

methods.name: EndEdit
methods.returnDescription: true if the edit was committed, false if it failed validation.
methods.description: Commits the cell that is currently being edited.
methods.expectedEffect: The pending edit is saved to the cell and the data source.

methods.name: ClearSelection
methods.expectedEffect: No cell or row is highlighted.

methods.name: AutoResizeColumns
methods.description: Resizes all columns to fit their content.
methods.expectedEffect: Each column becomes as wide as its widest value.

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Sorts the rows by a column (unbound or sortable bound data).
methods.expectedEffect: Rows are ordered by name from A to Z.

methods.name: AddNew
methods.description: Creates a new item in the list and makes it current.
methods.expectedEffect: A blank record is added and shown in bound controls.

methods.name: RemoveCurrent
methods.description: Removes the current item from the list.
methods.expectedEffect: The current record disappears and the next one becomes current.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.expectedEffect: Bound controls show the next record.

methods.name: MoveFirst
methods.expectedEffect: Bound controls show the first record.

methods.name: EndEdit
methods.description: Applies pending edits of the current item to the data source.
methods.expectedEffect: Edits made in bound controls are committed.

methods.name: ResetBindings
methods.description: Tells bound controls to reread the list.

parameters.name: metadataChanged
parameters.description: true if the structure (columns) changed, false if only the data changed.

methods.expectedEffect: Bound controls refresh with the current list contents.

methods.name: AddStandardItems
methods.description: Adds the standard buttons (First, Previous, Position, Count, Next, Last, Add, Delete) to the navigator.
